title: Molecular solar thermal energy storage devices: toward a more sustainable future
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8990-9017
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02556G, Review Article
Xingtang Xu, Chonghua Li, Wang Li, Jie Feng, Wen-Ying Li
This review highlights latest advances in molecular solar thermal (MOST) devices, analyzes emerging strategies and future opportunities, and aims to facilitate innovation and advancements in molecular energy storage.
